ambient_events: A barred hatch is set into the ceiling of this dead end. It has no handle on this side.
The muck here has been walked through, and recently, by someone who came back the same way.
Somebody has swept this sump. In the sewer, that is a stranger thing than a body would be.
description: A run of domestic storm line under Kessler Street, the walls streaked with a century of household runoff. Somewhere a broken pipe drips with idiot patience.
name: Drain Sump
